terms.intro: Welcome to XWorld Pocket Studio (the "App"). This agreement is made between you and the operator of the App regarding your use of its services. By registering, logging in or using the App, you are deemed to have read and accepted this agreement in full.
terms.serviceBody: The App is an AI short-drama production tool offering script writing, storyboard generation, video synthesis, credit recharge and work showcase. Features are subject to what the App actually provides; as we keep iterating, some features may be adjusted or discontinued.
terms.accountBody: 您可使用在本應用內註冊的帳號（使用者名稱/信箱/手機號碼 + 密碼）登入。請妥善保管帳號密碼，並對帳號下的全部行為負責；不得轉讓、出借帳號，發現被盜用應立即通知我們。
terms.creditsBody: AI generation features in the App are billed in credits. Credits are obtained via recharge and can only be used within the App; they are non-transferable and non-refundable (except where mandatory law applies or in special cases such as system failures). Please confirm the amount and package before paying.
terms.contentBody: Content you generate in the App (scripts, images, videos, etc.) must be used lawfully. AI-generated content may contain errors or inappropriate material; review it carefully before use, and disputes arising from its use are your own responsibility. You retain the rights to your own uploaded materials; ownership rules for generated content will follow the final legal version published at official launch.
terms.conductBody: You agree not to use the App to create or distribute content prohibited by laws and regulations (including but not limited to harmful political, pornographic, violent, infringing or false content), nor to engage in any conduct that endangers network security or infringes the lawful rights of others. We may suspend or terminate the service for violations and reserve the right to pursue liability.
terms.liabilityBody: We are not liable for service interruptions or losses caused by force majeure, network failures, third-party services (AI vendors, payment channels, etc.) or your own causes. The App is provided on an "as is" basis without any guarantee of specific results.
terms.changesBody: We may update this agreement based on business and legal requirements and will publish updates within the App. Your continued use of the App constitutes acceptance of the updated agreement; if you disagree, please stop using the App.

privacy.intro: We take your personal information seriously and process it in accordance with legal requirements and the principle of minimal necessity. Please read this policy carefully before using the App.
privacy.collectBody: Account profile (phone/email, nickname, avatar), creative content (scripts, images, audio and videos you upload or generate), device and log information (device model, OS version, IP address, operation logs), and order information necessary to complete payments.
privacy.useBody: To provide sign-in, AI generation, video synthesis and other core features, process recharge and credit settlement, secure accounts and transactions, improve the product experience, and send you necessary service notices.
privacy.storageBody: Your data is stored on our servers with security measures such as encryption in transit and at rest, and is kept only as long as necessary to deliver the features; after that we delete or anonymize it.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: 僅在為實現服務所必需時向以下第三方提供：微信支付（完成儲值支付）、AI 技術服務商（文字/圖片/音視訊生成，含將您的創作內容作為模型輸入）、雲服務與安全服務商。除此之外，未經您同意不對外提供。
privacy.rightsBody: You may access, correct or delete your personal information, cancel your account, withdraw your consent, or raise opinions and complaints about our processing of personal information, via in-app "Settings" or by contacting customer support.
privacy.minorsBody: The App is intended primarily for adults. Minors must use the App with guardian consent and under guardian supervision; if we learn that we hold a minor's information without such consent, we will delete it proactively.
privacy.changesBody: This policy may be updated from time to time. Updates will be published within the App, with prominent notice for major changes. Please review it regularly to stay informed of the latest version.

privacy.title: User Agreement & Privacy Policy
privacy.body: Welcome to XWorld Pocket Studio. We do not collect any information before you agree; after consent, we process necessary information (account profile, creative content, device and logs) per the Privacy Policy and disclose it to third parties such as the XWorld account center, WeChat Pay and AI service providers to deliver the service. Tapping "Agree & Continue" means you have read and accepted the User Agreement and Privacy Policy; you may also read the full text via "View Agreement" first.
privacy.exitBody: Without consent you cannot use the App. You may read the full agreements first, or exit the App.

tutorial.title: 新手教學
tutorial.heroD: 匯入劇本 → 提取角色場景 → 生成分鏡 → 一鍵合成影片，跟著下面的指引，幾步拍出你的第一部 AI 短劇。
tutorial.quickS: 跟著流程走，每步完成點「下一步」
tutorial.s1d: 點底部金色「+」新建專案，貼上或上傳已有劇本，一鍵拆分為分集（這一步不耗積分）。
tutorial.s2d: AI 自動提取角色、場景、道具，生成形象圖，還能為角色綁定配音音色和服飾。
tutorial.s3d: 逐鏡生成影片後合成全集，加字幕、線上剪輯，再一鍵分享或發布到展示中心。
tutorial.modulesT: 功能速覽 · 點開看怎麼做
tutorial.tip: 小提醒：AI 生成的背景任務都在「任務中心」看進度，關掉頁面任務不中斷；失敗會自動退款。
tutorial.ctaSub: 也可以在展示中心挑一部喜歡的劇，點「做同款」立刻開拍

showcase.1: 首頁瀏覽全站發布的短劇，下拉重新整理、上滑自動載入更多。
showcase.2: 頂部搜尋框按劇名檢索，點類型標籤按言情、懸疑等題材篩選。
showcase.3: 看到喜歡的劇，點「做同款」，AI 參考它幫你寫同類型劇本。

writer.1: 點底部「+」→「新建劇本」，和 AI 策劃聊天打磨你的創意。
writer.2: 依次點「生成大綱」→「分集+概要」→「細化」，每一步結果都可以手動修改。
writer.3: 填好專案名、題材與風格畫幅，點「匯出到專案」進入正式製作。
writer.t: AI 編劇 · 四步寫出劇本

workspace.1: 「作品」頁管理所有專案，卡片上的三段進度條標示走到了哪一步。
workspace.2: 工作台三張流程卡按順序點亮：劇本大綱 → 資產庫 → 分集與成片。
workspace.3: 建立者可在工作台「成員」裡邀請好友協作，按權限分工。

assets.1: 點「AI 提取資產」，AI 自動從劇本識別角色、場景、道具並建檔。
assets.2: 為資產生成形象圖，可掛參考圖控制畫風，支援批次生成。
assets.3: 角色可綁定配音音色、搭配多套服飾，設定全劇統一應用。
assets.4: 建議先調好角色與場景設定，再進入下一步。
assets.t: 資產庫 · 角色場景道具

episodes.1: 每集先「提取資產」再「生成分鏡」，就緒後選檔位合成整集（480p–4K）。
episodes.2: 點成片卡「CC」兩步出字幕：AI 識別生成草稿 → 校對後免費燒錄。
episodes.3: 頂部「一鍵分享」生成免登入播放連結，「發布」可上架展示中心。
episodes.4: 合成、生圖等操作前都會彈估價確認，取消任務自動退款。

edit.1: 分鏡編輯器逐鏡生成影片，勾選多鏡可批次（串行更連貫，並發更快）。
edit.2: 點「審計」一鍵查缺補漏：補缺失資產、按對白時長調整鏡頭時長。
edit.3: 成片進「剪輯」掐頭去尾，匯出為新的剪輯版。

tasks.1: 「任務」頁集中查看所有 AI 任務進度，關掉頁面任務不中斷。
tasks.2: 成功的任務點「查看結果」直達成品。
tasks.3: 失敗自動退款，排隊中的任務可隨時取消。

credits.1: 1 元 = 10 積分，每次 AI 生成前都會顯示預計消耗，確認後才執行。
credits.2: 在「我的」頁積分卡點「儲值」，支援微信支付。
credits.3: 積分明細隨時可查：儲值 / 消費 / 退款 / 結算。

more.1: 「接單中心」發布製作任務單或接單賺錢，平台託管結算有保障。
more.2: 「邀請有禮」邀請好友註冊，消費達標後雙方拿積分獎勵。
more.3: 「設定」裡可切換淺色 / 深色主題和介面語言。
